name: PixiBud smart tools execute Auto-Shade, Clean Jaggies, and Mood Tints
description: Verify opening the PixiBud smart assistant tab and triggering smart art actions including De-Jaggy, Thinning, and Atmosphere LUT presets.

planSteps.description: Click the drawing canvas to draw an initial mark
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel (data-testid tab-ai)
Verify the RotSprite 8x & Cleanup section is displayed with De-Jaggy and Thin to 1px controls
Verify the Color Science & Morphing section is displayed with Sunset, Moonlight, and Neon Atmosphere LUT options
Verify the Sunset mood tint is applied and the canvas workspace remains active
